kept.title: Two pages list the API usage tiers differently
kept.claim: The 429 troubleshooting page says there are three usage tiers (plus Custom). The rate limits page says there are three standard tiers and also an Evaluation tier that new organizations may start in. A reader of the first page would not know the Evaluation tier exists.

evidence.quote: There are three usage tiers: Start, Build, and Scale.
New organizations and organizations with limited usage history may start in the Evaluation tier

kept.title: A temporary notice about response times has no date
kept.claim: The page opens with a notice that response times are longer because of a "recent launch". It names no launch and no date, so a reader cannot tell whether it still applies.

evidence.quote: Our response times are currently longer than normal due to our recent launch

kept.title: "What interfaces can I use" reads as complete but the home page lists more products
kept.claim: The interfaces page introduces a list of five ways to access Claude. The home page lists Claude Code (in the terminal) as its own collection. A reader could take the shorter list as every way in.

evidence.quote: Use Claude in your terminal to write, review, and ship code.

kept.title: The documentation is called two different things
kept.claim: One page sends readers to "Claude Docs" at docs.claude.com. Another sends them to "Claude Platform Docs" for the same kind of reference. A reader cannot tell whether these are one site or two.

evidence.quote: You can access our API documentation by visiting our Claude Docs
see Rate limits in Claude Platform Docs

kept.title: A tax registration is described as coming "at the earliest" in a year that is now under way
kept.claim: The page, dated March 16, 2026, says registration for Japanese Consumption Tax will happen once a threshold is exceeded, "at the earliest as of FY2026". It does not say whether that has happened.

evidence.quote: at the earliest as of FY2026
